coastal.title: Investigation underway after fire at Vancouver's Plaza of Nations
coastal.description: The cause of a fire on the exterior of Vancouver's Plaza of Nations building on Monday evening is under investigation.

prince-george.title: Cole Hosack vanished from Dawson Creek, B.C., in 2023. Does this man know what happened to him?
prince-george.description: New evidence, including a potential confession, has been uncovered in an investigation by the CBC's the fifth estate into the suspicious disappearance of a man in northern British Columbia.

southeast.title: RCMP investigating trio of suspicious wildfires in Grand Forks, B.C.
southeast.description: Firefighters in Grand Forks, B.C., were called to three wildfires this weekend they say are suspicious.
